name: comp-436

frames.best_why: The selected Projects tab sits above a full three-row list, showing tab shape and panel together.

tagline: Browser-shaped icon tabs flip the panel content underneath.
summary: Three browser-style tabs with a house, panels and box icon switch the panel below between a deploy note, a project status list and package versions.
appearance: Flat-topped tabs with rounded upper corners and thin side borders sit along a hairline baseline on black, each with a small icon and label. The selected tab reads brighter and covers the line; below, small text or a two-column list fills the panel.
behaviour: Clicking a tab lifts it above the baseline and swaps the panel between a deployment note, a project list and package versions. Unchosen tabs fall back to dim grey.
demo_content: Tabs Overview, Projects, Packages; a Northwind Web deploy note; project names; two package versions.
search_phrases: folder style tabs for a web app
web browser look for app navigation
flat top tabs with rounded corners
use_when: Switching between a few app views when you want a familiar browser-tab feel.
avoid_when: When many tabs are needed: only three fit comfortably and the row scrolls instead of stacking.
customise: Each tab's label, icon and panel contents are written into the file, so a data-driven version means rewriting the triggers and panels. Active styling is class-based.
weight_why: Three tabs and a few short text panels; one lightweight state swap.

a11y.note: Labelled tabs with hidden icons give clean names and the panel text is real text; no reduced-motion handling.

issues: Inactive tab labels are low-contrast grey against the dark bar.
polish_why: Convincing browser-tab shape and clean panel type; inactive labels are a touch faint.
title: Browser Icon Tabs
